title: ICAN Graro official product page configuration recheck
notes: Live rendered-page readback on 2026-10-22 of the exact Graro page. Its Important Tips say that from 17 November 2025 the China-warehouse fork ships without mounting bolts by default (bolts on request by order note) and the seatpost ships with 0 mm offset by default (15 mm offset on request). The specification lists Front-160mm; Rear-140mm rotors, 100*12mm/142*12mm axles and a frame+fork+seatpost+bearings+thru axles+hanger package. Ordering the integrated handlebar adds the handlebar and spacers; adding a separate stem adds spacers and a top cap. The page states the frame can only be equipped with gravel groupsets and recommends at most 48-31T double or 42T single chainrings. This readback records what the page showed on 2026-10-22 only; it does not establish what the page showed on an earlier date, a rotor maximum beyond the listed sizes, or compatibility of any specific part. No price was recorded in this readback.
